name: Nad Chistym Nebom Lastochki Letayut
source:
The least expected person to take the place of the camp counselor at Sovyonok is a foreigner named Robert Brown, a lonely veteran. The stranger made him an offer he couldn't refuse... and, after teasing him with a life in paradise, pitted him against a destructive threat. To engage in a final battle with the nightmares from outside and inside - that's what Brown will do to save the camp, his new friends... or at least himself.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3597042310]Steam[/url]]
